subject: Post-call: sandbox contrast battery + parity probes
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: sandbox contrast battery + parity probes

Emily — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can align on the evaluation battery and avoid ambiguous comparisons vs the hyperscalers: 

Call highlights:
- Novus primary goal: pick a serving stack that meets latency SLOs for short chat interactions (~<150ms token P50), keeps hallucination rate under your risk threshold for KB-grounded responses, and stays within your cost envelope.
- You’re running baseline tests against CloudScale and VendorX today; want parity probes plus targeted hallucination checks.
- Compliance note: SOC2 evidence and a list of data flows will be required before pilot.

Proposed next tests (we attached the prompt battery):
1) Prompt battery (attachment: contrast-test-prompt-battery.csv) — 120 prompts split across factual grounding, extractive answers, instruction-following, and adversarial phrasings. We suggest running the battery on your sandbox for:
   - Production-like beam: 8/16 token cache settings; single-token streaming vs chunked streaming.
2) Hallucination probes — instrumented scoring: hallucination_count, hallucination_span_len, and faithfulness_score (we provide a scoring rubric).
3) Latency under dynamic batching — run 10-minute bursts at 50-150 rps to measure P50/P95/P99 and token throughput.
4) Regression checks — save a snapshot of outputs for each model/variant for deterministic prompt inputs so we can compare deltas.

Immediate asks from Novus:
- Can you provision sandbox API keys for us (read-only logs) and a short-lived dataset mount?
- Any redlines around token logging or retention? We will provide a SOC2-friendly retention config.

Next steps / timeline:
- If you can provision sandbox access by end-of-week, we’ll run the battery and return a summary within 72 hours.
- Suggest a follow-up sync on Mon 11/23 to review deltas and decide which deeper regression probes to run.

Attachments: contrast-test-prompt-battery.csv, sandbox-access-instructions.txt

Thanks — looping in Ben (SE) and Marissa (CS) for the test plan and operation checklist.

— Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0192 | diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Emily Park <emily.park@novus.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: sandbox contrast battery + parity probes

Diego / Emily — thanks, great summary. A few concrete technical clarifications and additions to the plan: 

- Prompt groups: we'll tag each prompt with an "anchor" expected answer for automated diffing. For ambiguous prompts we add a gold response from Novus to reduce false positives on hallucination detection.
- Models/variants to run: r-infer-1.0 (fp16), r-infer-1.0-q4, r-infer-1.1-latency-optim, plus CloudScale-gptx and VendorX-std as references.
- Measurement hooks: please give us (sandbox) a read-only API key and an endpoint that includes request_id in headers so we can map logs to prompts. We will not persist raw tokens longer than 30 days unless Novus requests otherwise.
- Scoring thresholds (proposal): hallucination_count <= 3 per 100 prompts for extractive tasks; faithfulness_score >= 0.92 for factual tasks. We can adjust after the first run.

I attached a short test-plan draft with command lines and expected output formats. If Novus prefers, we can run the first pass from our infra and share sanitized artifacts.

(attachment: ben-test-plan.md)

-Ben
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Park <emily.park@novus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novus.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: sandbox contrast battery + parity probes

Thanks Diego — and Ben, this looks good. A couple of clarifications from Novus side: 

- SOC2: we can share the specific controls we need covered; please point us to your SOC2 scope doc.
- Data access: we cannot share customer PII in the prompts; we'll scrub any PII before providing gold answers.
- Token logging: we can accept read-only logs but need assurance that logs are encrypted and access is audited; retention ideally <= 30 days.
- Timeline: we can provision a sandbox endpoint by EOD Thursday (11/19) if Redwood sends instructions. Priya (cc’d) will review the initial results.

On hallucination thresholds: the suggested numbers seem like a reasonable starting point. We want to see the delta vs CloudScale for both hallucination_count and latency under burst. Can you include a simple plot template in the Drive link so our analytics team can layer the outputs?

Onwards — forward the sandbox setup steps and we’ll get keys out.

Thanks,
Emily
Senior Product Manager, Novus AI

Emily — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary and confirmation of next steps: 

1) Redwood action items (by Fri EOD 11/20):
   - Send sandbox provisioning steps and the read-only key pattern (attachment: sandbox-access-instructions.txt).
   - Upload a plotting template and result CSV format to the Drive link so Novus analytics can ingest outputs.
   - Run an internal dry-run of the 120-prompt battery against r-infer-1.0 and r-infer-1.0-q4, share sanitized deltas.

2) Novus action items (by Mon 11/23):
   - Provide sandbox endpoint and keys; supply gold responses for ambiguous prompts where available.
   - Priya will review results and flag any SOC2 scope items.

3) Follow-up sync: Mon 11/23 10am PT (I'll put a calendar invite). If the sandbox is live earlier we can shift sooner.

4) Risk/constraints: please confirm token logging retention (we propose default 30 days, adjustable) and whether Novus needs any additional contractual language re: logs.

Thanks again — Ben, Marissa: can you own the dry-run and the initial sanitized report? Emily/Priya: once you share keys we’ll start the run and aim to deliver a delta summary within 72 hours.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
